fact: The RACHAD II expenditure-chain system was deployed in 2021, and the ARKAM treasury accounting system, in place since 2022, continued to be rolled out to the remaining accounting posts in 2023 and 2024 and is interfaced with RACHAD, the tax system JIBAYA and the central bank system.
title: Rapport sur la mise en oeuvre de la LOLF (annexe PLFI 2025)
publisher: Ministère de l'Economie et des Finances
